reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V1 (the agent's recommended ship variant): yaw_rate_pred = (v/L)*tan(delta) with canonical wheelbase L per platform (Mach-E 2.984 m, F-150 3.70 m), minus a per-segment straight-line yaw-gyro bias computed as mean(ks_pred - meas) over samples with |delta_road|<0.01 rad (needs >5 such samples, else bias=0) — exactly the recipe in tools/run_ladder.py.
notes: V1 recipe (per-segment straight-line yaw-gyro bias subtraction from KS) applied uniformly to both Mach-E and F-150 segments; agent only fit/reported on Mach-E, so F-150 biases are new but use the same deterministic recipe.
